<a id="body"></a>

## Body

Copilot auto-compacts a seat near its window limit. Bobcat (gpt-6.1-sol, 922k window) went from 754k at 05:20 to 233k by 05:45 on 08 Nov, via session.compaction_complete at 05:22, while my handshake was pending. Before sending --command compact, re-read the footer. If it is under 600k, cancel and tell the seat in one line; the handover stays on file. Compaction times: ~/.copilot/session-state/<session>/events.jsonl, types session.compaction_start and session.compaction_complete (session id from pij-rs --json state <seat>). Also: gpt-6.1-sol footers read 'NNNk/922k'; 922k is the window, not usage.
